entries.zh: 一个经修饰的粒子场可以有效地将我们的舰船“隐藏”在开阔的太空中。然而，作为代价，这将会破坏通常情况下能够保护舰船的能量护盾的稳定性。
entries.en: A modified particle field allows our vessels to effectively 'hide' in open space. However, this comes at the cost of destabilizing other forms of energy shielding which would otherwise protect the ship.

entries.zh: 稀有水晶透镜磨制技术的进步能够大幅提升隐形效率。
entries.en: Advancements in rare crystal lensing technology have greatly improved cloaking efficiency.

entries.zh: 以往典型的隐形技术会对舰船上相对精密的仪器造成严重的损害。但是精英隐形场的出现让这样的担忧显得过时。
entries.en: Typical cloaking technology can play havoc with a ship's more delicate instruments. However, these elite fields render such concerns obsolete.

entries.zh: 该装置使用暗物质以扭曲舰船周围的时空，使得其极难被侦测到。
entries.en: This device uses dark matter to warp space-time around the vessel, making it incredibly difficult to detect.

entries.zh: 灵能相位场发生器能够聚焦船员的灵能潜势，从而将舰船部分相位潜入到虚境中。这将使得舰船只能被最好的传感阵列探测到，尽管在这种情况下船员被迫要面对的事还是最好别说了。
entries.en: Psi-Phase Field Generators focus the psionic potential of the ship's crew to partially phase the vessel into the Shroud. This allows the ship to remain undetected by all but the best sensor arrays, though what the crew may be forced to witness is better left unsaid.

entries.zh: 暗物质共振室能够显著地提升我们探测阵列的性能。
entries.en: Dark matter resonance chambers will significantly improve the performance of our detection arrays.

entries.zh: 将探测阵列和科研舰舰载电脑耦合在一起能够极大地提升扫描分辨率。
entries.en: Coupling detection arrays with the computers onboard our science vessels can vastly increase their scanning resolution.

entries.zh: 隐形场发生器能够让我们的舰船在传统的传感器面前隐匿起来。
entries.en: Cloaking field generators allow our vessels to hide from conventional sensors.

entries.zh:
$CLOAKING_SHIELD_REDUCTION_HEADER$§R100%§!

§E如果仅装备有灵能屏障或者灵能护盾则可以避免$SHIP_SHIELD_REDUCTION_CLOAKING$。装有任何其他类型的护盾都会失去该效果。§!
entries.en:
$CLOAKING_SHIELD_REDUCTION_HEADER$ §R100%§!

§E$SHIP_SHIELD_REDUCTION_CLOAKING$ can be prevented if Psionic Barriers or Psionic Shields are equipped on their own. The use of any other shield type will negate this effect.§!

entries.zh: 一套强大的外部传感器，能够探测隐形舰队。\n
entries.en: A high-powered suite of external sensors, capable of detecting cloaked fleets.\n

entries.zh: 通过将暗物质激发到共振态，这个舱室能够大幅增强我们的探测阵列。\n
entries.en: By exciting dark matter into a resonant state, this chamber will greatly improve our Detection Arrays.\n

entries.zh: 该监听站能够进行特殊的隐形探测，其强大的传感器套件由一个独立的暗物质共振室所增强。\n
entries.en: Capable of exceptional cloaking detection, this Listening Post's suite of powerful sensors is boosted by a self-contained dark matter resonance chamber.\n

entries.zh: §E§H隐形强度§!用以衡量能够将所有舰队中的舰船覆盖的隐形场的稳定性。隐形场的稳定性越高，舰队在隐形时受到的惩罚越少。舰队中隐形场的最大稳定性取决于其中隐形强度最低的舰船。§!
entries.en: §E§HCloaking Strength§! is a measure of the stability of the Cloaking Field that surrounds all ships in the fleet. The higher the stability of a Cloaking Field, the fewer penalties the fleet suffers while cloaked. The maximum stability of a fleet is determined by the ship with the lowest individual Cloaking Strength.§!

entries.zh: §E§H探测强度§!用以衡量空间站配备的探测阵列的灵敏度。探测阵列的灵敏度越高，阵列就可穿透越强大的隐形场。§!
entries.en: §E§HDetection Strength§! is a measure of the sensitivity of the Detection Arrays equipped on the Station. The higher the sensitivity of the Detection Arrays, the more powerful a Cloaking Field the arrays can penetrate.§!

entries.zh: 隐形时，该舰队将遭受以下惩罚：
entries.en: While cloaked, this fleet suffers the following penalties:

entries.zh:
提高隐形能力会减轻全部惩罚。
降低隐形能力会提高全部惩罚。

$SHIP_SHIELD_REDUCTION_CLOAKING$将依据装配的隐形力场发生器部件，对每一艘舰船单独生效。
entries.en:
Increasing Cloaking Strength will reduce any penalties.
Decreasing Cloaking Strength will increase any penalties.

$SHIP_SHIELD_REDUCTION_CLOAKING$ applies on a per ship basis and depends on the equipped Cloaking Field Generator component.

entries.en: \nThis station is capable of projecting an exceptionally dynamic Cloaking Field, rendering it undetectable to conventional sensor arrays.

entries.en: \nThis station is capable of projecting a simple Cloaking Field, capable of evading basic detection systems.

entries.en: \nThis station is capable of projecting a moderate Cloaking Field, capable of evading standard sensor arrays.

entries.en: \nThis station is capable of projecting a dynamic Cloaking Field, capable of evading advanced sensor networks.

entries.en: \nThis station is capable of projecting an incredibly complex Cloaking Field, capable of evading all but the most sophisticated detection systems.

entries.en: This system has a $VALUE$ £ship_stats_cloaking_detection£ Detection Strength, which will reveal our Cloaked fleet.

entries.en: This system has an $CLOAKING_DETECTION_UNKNOWN$ £ship_stats_cloaking_detection£ Detection Strength, improving our Intel may change this.

entries.zh: 没有什么比自然进化更有创新力的了。通过研究前超光速文明社会是如何看待它们的世界，我们设计了新的方法以探测不速之舰船。
entries.en: Nothing is more innovative than natural evolution. By studying how pre-FTL societies view their world, we have devised new methods of detecting uninvited ships.

entries.zh: §H监听哨站§!为每§Y3§!个§H$sm_detection_array_plural$§!提供§G+1§!探测强度和探测距离
entries.en: §HListening Posts§! provide §G+1§! Detection Strength and Sensor Range for every §Y3§! §H$sm_detection_array_plural$§!

entries.zh: 通过研究数个前超光速文明，我们意识到还存在很多计量宇宙的方法。这甚至能够将新的数字引入到我们的数学体系中。
entries.en: After studying multiple pre-FTL civilizations, we have realized that there are many alternative ways to calculate the universe. It has even introduced new numbers into our mathematics.

entries.zh: 不同的社会发展出了不同的解答方案以适应它们的逻辑和计算机技术。这些外星人的思考方式能让我们更轻易地适应外星帝国的社会结构。
entries.en: Different societies have developed alternative solutions for their logistics and computing. These alien ways of thinking have made it easier for us to adapt to foreign empires' structures.

entries.zh: 得益于对围绕前超光速星球的观测站的大规模运作经验，我们发现了些许的优化空间。通过将这些优化推广到整个国家的范围，我们能够彻底降低空间站所需的维护费用。
entries.en: Due to our vast experience operating observation stations in orbit of pre-FTL worlds, we have discovered slight optimizations. By implementing them empire-wide, we can drastically reduce the maintenance our stations require.

entries.zh: 就像聪明的前超光速文明如何运动以在面对敌人的时候隐藏彼此一样，我们的飞行员可以学习到如何飞行的更快且不干扰到隐形场。
entries.en: Just like how clever pre-FTLs move to conceal each other as they approach an enemy, so too can our pilots move faster without disrupting their cloaking field.

entries.zh: 由于隐形造成的亚光速航速下降：§G-50%§!
没有什么比恰到好处的侮辱更强力的了，我们现在已经知道了如何用数种语言辱骂其他一个物种的祖先。
entries.en: Nothing is quite as powerful as a well-placed insult, and we now know how to insult a species's progenitor in many languages.

entries.zh: 每§Y五年§!从羞辱另一个帝国获得收益。
entries.en: Gain a benefit for insulting another empire every §Y5 years§!.

entries.zh: \n\n在当前修正失效前，我们不能享受§H令人满意的羞辱§!带来的益处。
entries.en: \n\nWe can not gain the benefit of §HSatisfying Insults§! until the current modifier expires.

entries.zh: \n\n我们会获得§H令人满意的羞辱§!修正，持续5年，同时获得§G50§!£influence£影响力。
entries.en: \n\nWe will gain the §HSatisfying Insult§! modifier for 5 years as well as §G50§! £influence£ Influence.

entries.zh: 令人满意的侮辱技巧可用
我们的[Root.GetLinguists]已经完成了一种新的令人满意的侮辱技巧。我们现在就只剩找到一个目标来使用它了。
entries.en: Our [Root.GetLinguists] have finished developing a new satisfying insult. We just need to find a target for it.

entries.zh: 尽管没有一个文明在治理管辖一个不断发展的国家时找到了解决不断扩增的挑战的完美解决方案，我们还是发现了部分的解决办法。在研究了数个物种及其政府之后，我们发现了在灵活性和功能性之间的卓越的平衡点。
entries.en: While no one civilization has the perfect solution to the ever-expanding challenge of governing a growing nation, we have found a partial solution. After studying a multitude of species and governments, we have discovered an outstanding balance of flexibility and function.

entries.zh: 文明通常在能够促进其成长的位置勃勃生机，通过分析前太空文明定居发展的主要地点，我们的殖民地可以学习到很多。
entries.en: Civilizations flourish in locations that promotes growth, and by analyzing where the majority of pre-FTL settlements thrive we can gain more out of our colonies.

entries.zh: 在分析了大量来自迥然不同的文化的艺术家之后，我们得到了一个泛用的理论。通过研究一个文明的艺术和文化，我们能够在同它们的战斗中取得优势。
entries.en: After analyzing a multitude of artists from drastically different cultures, we have come up with a general theorem. By studying a civilization's art and culture, we can gain an advantage against them in combat.

entries.zh: 任何拥有足够长历史的文明都有由已经被遗忘的古文明建立的奇观，这些奇观已经无法被复现了。幸运的是，我们拥有这些曾经在这些前超光速文明世界出现的古王国的档案。
entries.en: Any civilization with a long enough history has examples of great wonders built by forgotten ancients which can no longer be replicated. Luckily for us we have documented these great ancients when they appeared on pre-FTL worlds.

entries.zh: 我们曾经以为最好的合金，结果远非如此。编目了数不清的前超光速文明的精炼过程，现在我们可以合成一种无可匹敌的金属。
entries.en: What we thought was the greatest alloy turned out to be far from the truth. Countless pre-FTL refining processes have been cataloged, and we have now synthesized an unbeatable metal.

entries.zh: 尽管研究战斗中的胜利者可能是能从战斗中获得见解最明显的办法，但观察前超光速文明中的落败者也教会了我们如何组织更有效率的撤退。
entries.en: While studying the victors of battles might be the most obvious way to gain insight from combat, observing the loser on pre-FTL worlds has taught us how to organize our withdraws more effectively.

entries.zh: 交通网络将人们聚集到一起：这是从我们观察到的许多文明所具有的共同情感。尽管我们已经不用蒸汽引擎了，我们的超空间中继网络能起到类似的作用。
entries.en: Transportation networks bring people together: a sentiment shared by many civilization we observed. While we do not have steam engines, our hyper relay networks could serve a similar purpose.

entries.en: §E§H$HYPERLANE_RANGE$§! is the maximum range at which hyperlanes can be detected from this Station.§!

entries.en: §E§H$SENSOR_RANGE$§! is the maximum range at which this Station's sensors can function.§!

entries.en: Your fleet will be detected and forced to decloak in this system.
